_archive_candidates.name: Bachelor of Accounting
_archive_candidates.reason: Real UC course code MGB001 found and verified live. The page explicitly states 'Periods course is open for new admissions: This course is not open for new admissions.' Only one version (v1) exists, and its default/most-recent year is 2025 (page banner: 'Please note these are the 2025 details for this course'). No 2026, 2027, or 2028 version exists for MGB001 in UC's current course sitemap (services/wcm/site-map/course.xml) or via direct year/version probing (checked v1-v3, years 2023-2028). UC's current live undergraduate business catalogue (MGB1xx series) has majors in HRM (MGB103), International Business (MGB104), Management (MGB105), Marketing (MGB106), Sport Management (MGB108) and general Business (MGB109), but no standalone Accounting bachelor's degree or Accounting major bachelor code currently live; accounting study now lives inside the Bachelor of Business as the Specialist Major in Accounting (SM0016, https://www.canberra.edu.au/major/SM0016/1), and separately as the standalone Master of Professional Accounting (297JA, live for 2026/2027). Do not reuse SM0016 major content as if it were this distinct discontinued degree.
_archive_candidates.evidence_url_or_note: https://www.canberra.edu.au/course/MGB001/1/2025 (title: 'Bachelor of Accounting (MGB001) - University of Canberra', admissions-closed banner present); cross-checked against https://www.canberra.edu.au/services/wcm/site-map/course.xml (no MGB001 entry, no accounting-named MGB1xx code)

_archive_candidates.name: Graduate Certificate in Accounting
_archive_candidates.reason: Real UC course code MGC001 found and verified live. Page explicitly states 'This course is not open for new admissions.' Two versions exist (v1 -> 2021, v2 -> 2024); no version redirects to 2026/2027/2028 and MGC001 is absent from the current course sitemap. 'About this course' prose (real, sourced) describes it as being for students with an overseas accounting qualification needing 4 units (12cp), explicitly not meeting professional-body accreditation as a standalone award, with a described pathway 'to progress to UC's G[raduate Diploma in Accounting]' (text was cut off in extraction but the pattern matches the Grad Dip page's parallel pathway sentence to the Master's). This is one exit-award tier in a discontinued Accounting-pathway ladder (Grad Cert -> Grad Dip -> Master of Professional Accounting), and the ladder's lower two rungs (Grad Cert, Grad Dip) have been retired while the top rung, Master of Professional Accounting (297JA), remains live for 2026/2027.
_archive_candidates.evidence_url_or_note: https://www.canberra.edu.au/course/MGC001/2/2024 (title: 'Graduate Certificate in Accounting (MGC001) - University of Canberra', admissions-closed banner present, 'Please note these are the 2024 details for this course')
